text:
for some reason, my professor for my met instruments class banned the use of tablets to take notes. i didn't realize this and used my ipad for notes yesterday, and at the end of class he pointed it out to me and said it was because "a past student spent too long making their notes look pretty"

...but i don't do that at all?? i told him this and he didn't care, told me to give it 3 weeks to try it out

the logic here makes no sense. i've done my notes on my ipad for every single class since day one. it's better in every way over doing notes on actual paper. this is so stupid and i don't want to comply but i also don't want to argue (prof's otherwise a great guy)

topReplies.author: Nixywulf AD
topReplies.text: so if it aint a big deal let it ride otherwise you could ask him to accommodate it or go to dean of students/student services for ADA accommodations
2 years ago today - Mt. Mitchell, and a bear
